selection: Ten contiguous equal-line tiles fixed before new tile imagery was projected; no skipped intervals.
projection: Same OHRC SPICE/ASP-aligned TMC DTM and fixed image-derived pointing prior as aligned_candidate_config_v1.json; full 12000-sample width; no percentile spatial trim.
whole_overlap_rule: REGISTERED only if all ten tiles have valid camera/DTM coverage across the true pixel overlap and both matchers pass their fixed gates in every tile; any unsupported or failed tile retains ABSTAIN. Existing development tile results are diagnostic, not fresh blind validation.
